name: Endogenous Ecological Constraint Redistribution
hypothesis: An inhabitant-produced ecological constraint within fixed resource-accounted physics may change which latent evolutionary pathways become reachable and selectively useful; any new function must be demonstrably inherited in independently viable descendants without novelty rewards or automatic collective copying.
original_contribution: Prospective causal comparison of exogenous dominant-route knockouts, endogenous ecological route constraint, matching generic external nutrient flux, and function- versus morphology-based success. It is a new research comparison, not a published general law.

independent_measurements.name: physical possibility
independent_measurements.falsifier: candidate transition only exists when investigator adds a new primitive

independent_measurements.name: reachability
independent_measurements.falsifier: alternative pathway appears at the same rate and cost with or without proposed ecological constructor

independent_measurements.name: ecological cause
independent_measurements.falsifier: external matched material predicts the same outcomes as particular producer

independent_measurements.name: blind function and cost
independent_measurements.falsifier: visual novelty is present but survival/reproductive advantage absent after full costs

independent_measurements.name: functional descendant reproduction
independent_measurements.falsifier: daughter offspring requires special engine copy or researcher partner repair

independent_measurements.name: generalization under change
independent_measurements.falsifier: benefit disappears after sealed resource/partner reversal

prospective_competitors: researcher dominant-path knockout as shortcut control
explicit novelty reward as false-positive control
altered lineage history under fixed primitive physics
shuffled lineages and matched mutation supply
blind new ecology and independent descendants
counterevidence: 200/200 success cannot be assumed: Lind 2015 observed 91/200 with alternatives under its selection window
Taylor 2016 same colony morphology can arise without new mutations and does not measure novel fitness
Johnson 2022 robustness does not consistently expand across environments
Routh 2025 stable specialization can reduce later adaptability and new mutations rather than hidden variants dominate
Sakuma 2026 functional substate redistribution is in vitro single-molecule measurement along preselected trajectories; not organismal ecology
Kaltenbach 2016 refuted simple native-activity robustness explanation of apparent enzyme trade-offs
reject_if: benefit disappears under producer knockout and matched exogenous rescue shows only extra calories
equivalent benefit occurs under random mutations and fixed feedback without altered ecology
candidate requires explicit path-reward or researcher-created group copy
only morphological labels change, not causal net survival
statistical independence treats clones or sequenced molecules as independently evolved whole populations
only surviving/photogenic lineages used in denominators
